about: Side-by-side screen recordings for the README. Each case is a task from the 125-task real-website set on which WebJev-35B-A3B succeeded and Jev 1.13 failed in the benchmark run. Every task was re-recorded three times per model with the same browser agent (decision model alone), the same Lexmount cloud browser and the same text helper (deepseek-v4.1-flash); every take was graded by the task's deterministic verifier. Each GIF shows one take per model; take_outcomes lists all takes (S success, F failure, J not gradable).
playback: real time (1x) while both agents run; a longer failing run is fast-forwarded after the other finishes, and the badge says so. Clocks start at each agent's first decision.

cases.task: On apple.com, open the Tech Specs page for the currently offered MacBook Air and leave the specifications displayed.
cases.title_shown: On apple.com, open the Tech Specs page for the currently offered MacBook Air and leave the specifications displayed.

webjev.what_it_did: Mac -> MacBook Air -> scrolled to the page menu -> Tech Specs.

jev.how_it_failed: Opened the MacBook Air buy page instead of Tech Specs, then clicked the search icon over and over until the agent stopped it for repeating itself.

cases.task: On gov.uk, use the Check if you need a UK visa service to check whether an American citizen with no dual British or Irish citizenship needs a visa to work in healthcare in the UK for longer than 6 months. Leave the completed checker result page open and return only a JSON object with the boolean field "visa_required".
